title: Generalizing Protein Fitness Prediction Across Distribution Shifts via Structural and Co-evolutionary Priors
authors: Vithayapalert N; Piriyajitakonkij M; Grisoni F
one_liner_zh: 该文利用结构感知蛋白语言模型与AlphaFold风格trunk特征结合，预测蛋白质适应度并提升分布偏移下的泛化能力，核心涉及蛋白质结构计算建模，与课题高度相关。
abstract: Protein fitness prediction is essential for protein engineering. Recent fitness-landscape benchmarks such as FLIP2 have shown that methods performing well under conventional train-test splits can fail when the test set is shifted out of distribution (OOD), including mutations at unseen positions and variants from unseen protein backbones. In particular, current protein language models (pLMs) often suffer substantial performance degradation under such distribution shifts, limiting their practical use in protein engineering. We therefore develop a framework that augments sequence representations with structural and co-evolutionary information for fitness prediction. Specifically, we pair structure-aware pLMs with features pooled from an AlphaFold-style trunk applied to each sequence and its multiple sequence alignment (MSA), and use a lightweight prediction probe to map these frozen representations to fitness scores. Our framework consistently outperforms the best previously reported FLIP2 scores across several types of distribution shift. We then systematically study the contribution of each component in our framework to generalization. Structural priors yield the largest performance gains on held-out protein backbones, whereas trunk features improve generalization to held-out mutation positions. Rather than proposing a single best method, we characterize which modalities are effective for different protein families and distribution shifts, providing practical guidance for choosing representations according to the generalization regime. These findings support the development of more generalizable fitness predictors that can serve as effective reward functions or oracles for protein design toward desired functions.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质适应性预测对于蛋白质工程至关重要。近期如FLIP2等适应性景观基准测试表明，在传统训练-测试划分下表现良好的方法，在测试集发生分布外（OOD）偏移时可能失效，包括在未见位置上的突变和来自未见蛋白质骨架的变体。特别是，当前的蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）在此类分布偏移下常遭受显著的性能下降，限制了它们在蛋白质工程中的实际应用。因此，我们开发了一个框架，通过将序列表示与结构和共进化信息相结合来进行适应性预测。具体而言，我们将结构感知的pLMs与从AlphaFold风格主干（trunk）中提取的特征配对，该主干应用于每个序列及其多序列比对（MSA），并使用轻量级预测探针将这些冻结的表示映射到适应性分数。我们的框架在多种分布偏移类型上持续优于先前报道的最佳FLIP2分数。随后，我们系统研究了框架中每个组件对泛化的贡献。结构先验在未见蛋白质骨架上带来最大的性能提升，而主干特征则改善了对未见突变位置的泛化。我们并非提出单一最佳方法，而是刻画了不同模态对不同蛋白质家族和分布偏移的有效性，为根据泛化场景选择表示提供了实用指导。这些发现支持开发更具泛化能力的适应性预测器，这些预测器可作为蛋白质设计朝向目标功能的有效奖励函数或预言机。
